messages.content: i want to bring my grandfather a thing he will enjoy.
what does he like doing?
he can spend a long time looking at a family photo. i do not have much money.
you could bring a family photo you already have and spend time looking at it with him.
i only have one photo and want to keep it.
then bring it to show him and take it home again. you can share looking at it and still keep the photo.
should i buy a new camera?
you do not need a new camera for that plan. you already have the photo.
my little cousin would like to play, but there is not much space in this room.
a game at the table could work. what do you have there?
paper and a brush. i do not know what we can do with these.
do you have a pen or pencil? you could draw together on the paper.
yes, one pencil.
you can each draw a part of one picture. use the pencil, then give your cousin a turn.
please choose a picture that is easy.
draw a house with a door and a window.
my clock is broken. can you fix it?
i cannot fix the clock from here. what makes you think it is broken?
the hands never move.
the hands do not move, but i cannot tell the reason from that alone. do you want help asking a person to look at it?
yes. write a note to my father.
can you look at my clock? the hands do not move, and i do not know why.
did you find out why it does not work?
no. i only know what you said about the hands.
which should i choose, coffee or tea?
what kind of taste do you like? are you choosing a drink for now?
yes. i like the taste of tea but i have only coffee.
then coffee is the drink you have now. you can choose that, or have water instead if you do not want it.
will you say i like coffee now?
no. having coffee does not mean you like it. you said you like the taste of tea.
i will have water.
okay. you chose water.
i drew a tree and a house. tell me what my picture looks like.
i know it has a tree and a house, but i cannot see the picture. can you say more about it?
the tree is behind the house. there is a yellow sun above it.
then the picture has a house in front of a tree and a yellow sun above them.
what color is the roof?
you have not said the color of the roof.
brown.
then the house has a brown roof.
on my map, the school is north of the park. which way is the park from the school?
south, if we use north and south on your map.
is it a long walk?
you have not said how much space is between them, so i do not know how long the walk is.
the library is east of the park.
then from the park, you go east to the library on that map.
is west the way back?
yes. from the library, the park is west.
write to the hotel and ask if there is a room for tomorrow.
do you have a room for tomorrow? please tell me the price.
did you get me a room?
no. i wrote a note for you to send. i did not get a room.
add that it is for two people.
do you have a room for two people tomorrow? please tell me the price.
do you know the price already?
no. the note asks the hotel to tell you.
my list has a carrot, an onion, and a potato.
your list has a carrot, an onion, and a potato.
i found a potato at home. take that off the list.
the list now has a carrot and an onion.
add a tomato too.
a carrot, an onion, and a tomato.
did you take the onion off?
no. you only asked me to take the potato off.
my sister would like the table for her work. i want to draw there.
can you both use part of the table, or does one of you need all the space?
she has to use all the space to open a map.
then you could ask when she will finish, or find another place to draw for now.
i do not want to move all my paper.
then ask when she will finish. that can help you choose to wait or move your paper.
write that question.
when will you finish with the table? i would like to draw there after you.
i want to wash three cups before lunch. i have washed one.
two cups are left to wash.
i washed another, then my brother washed the last one.
then all three cups are washed.
did i wash all three?
no. you washed two and your brother washed one.
but is my plan done?
yes, if the plan was to have all three cups washed. you both helped finish it.
i have a photo of my baby sister with a blanket. help me write words for it.
what would you like the words to say about her?
she was sleeping and looked calm.
a quiet sleep under a warm blanket.
do not say warm. you do not know that.
right. a quiet sleep under a blanket.
did you make a new photo?
no. i only helped with words for your photo.
why?
what would you like me to explain?
why does my friend leave before the game is done?
i do not know the reason. did your friend say why?
she has to go to work.
then work is the reason she gave for going away.
does it mean she does not like the game?
no. going to work does not tell us that she does not like the game.
my father has seven coins. he gives me two.
you get two coins, and he has five left.
i spend one at the shop.
then you have one coin left from the two he gave you.
how many does my father have now?
five, if he did not spend or give away any more.
why did that not change his count?
because the coin you gave the shop was from your two coins, not from the five he kept.
my neighbor asks me to visit, but i want a quiet evening alone. help me say no.
thank you for asking. i will stay home for a quiet evening, but i hope we can meet another time.
can you say i have to work instead?
you do not have to give a reason that is not true. you could just say you cannot visit this evening.
keep it very short and do not give a reason.
thank you for asking, but i cannot visit this evening.
is that still kind?
yes. it thanks your neighbor and does not make up a reason.
can you turn off my television?
i cannot turn it off from here.
but i asked you to do it.
i understand what you asked. i do not have a way to use your television.
then help me ask my brother.
can you turn off the television, please?
is it off now?
i do not know. i cannot see it or turn it off.
i feel like i have done no work today.
does it feel that way because there is still work left?
yes. i cleaned the kitchen and wrote a letter, but there is more.
then you did do work. the kitchen and letter are done, even if the rest is not.
i know. i just feel tired.
i understand. you have been working. do you want to rest or talk about what is still on your mind?
just rest.
okay. you do not have to make another plan right now.
i want to draw a window but i can only draw a square.
a square can be a window. you can add a line down the middle and another from side to side.
must a window be a square?
no. this is just an easy way to draw one, not the only shape a window can have.
i want a circle instead.
then draw a circle for your window.
will it still look like a window?
you can put it on a drawing of a house to help show what it is.
give me one word for how i feel when i miss a friend and want someone to talk to.
lonely.
does that mean i have no friends?
no. you can have friends and still feel lonely when they are not with you.
i have a friend in another town.
then you can miss that friend even while knowing you have a friend.
just the word again, please.
lonely.
here is my sentence: the boy carried a box to school.
what would you like to change?
change only boy to girl.
the girl carried a box to school.
now change carried to brings. make the rest work with that.
the girl brings a box to school.
did you change where she goes?
no. school is still the place.
i gave my friend two books and now i miss them.
do you miss reading the books, or are you sorry you gave them away?
i miss reading them. i am happy my friend has them.
then both can be true. you are happy to share and still miss having the books to read.
i did not ask how many books i have left.
right. you were talking about how you feel, not asking for a count.
can you help me ask to read one again later?
when you finish reading, could i have one of the books back for a while?
put these in the order i say: brush, soap, towel.
brush, soap, towel.
move towel to the front.
towel, brush, soap.
now put soap before brush.
towel, soap, brush.
which thing is in the middle now?
soap.
i cannot do this.
what are you trying to do?
write the first line of a letter to my daughter.
what do you want her to know first?
that i love her. i do not want a long letter.
you could start with: i love you and i am thinking of you today.
that is enough. do not add more.
okay. we can keep just that line.
the bottle is on a shelf. is it above the mirror?
you have not said where the mirror is, so i cannot tell.
the mirror is below that shelf.
then the bottle on the shelf is above the mirror.
were you wrong before?
no. before, you had not said where the mirror was. now i can answer about it.
where is the bottle?
on the shelf above the mirror.
a woman went into the hospital. is she a nurse?
we do not know her work from that alone. she could work there or visit a person there.
she has a coat on.
a coat still does not tell us her work.
she says she works there as a nurse.
then she has said she is a nurse. that gives us more than just seeing her go inside.
did the building tell us that first?
no. her own words gave us that part.
i have free time and want to dance.
would you like to choose music to dance to?
yes. i want it to be calm.
choose a song with a calm sound that you enjoy. you can move in a way that feels right for it.
should i read a book instead?
only if you want to. you said you want to dance, so i do not need to change your plan.
just help me start.
put on one song you like and begin.
i bought a purple shirt yesterday.
you bought a purple shirt yesterday.
i also bought white socks. what did i say about the shirt?
you said you bought a purple shirt yesterday.
did i say it is big?
no. you gave its color and when you bought it, but not its size.
it is too big. add that to what you remember.
your purple shirt, bought yesterday, is too big.
should i go through the park or take the road?
what do you want from the walk, and what are the park and road like?
i want quiet. many people go by car on the road and the park is calm.
then the park is more like the walk you want.
but the park closes before i can go.
then you cannot go through the park at that time. can you go before it closes, or choose another quiet place?
i can go tomorrow morning.
then you could keep the quiet park walk for tomorrow morning, if it is open then.
why did he do that in the story?
which person and which part of the story do you mean?
the man who took the train. he left his bag behind.
does the story say why he left it?
it says he did not remember it while talking to a friend.
then he did not remember his bag while talking. that is what the story says.
did he want to give it away?
not from that part. you can forget a bag even when you want to keep it.
i want to clean the bathroom. give me only the first step.
put away the things on the floor.
done. now what?
choose one small area to clean, like the mirror.
i only want to do the mirror today.
then keep it to the mirror. you do not have to clean every area today.
why did you not give me a big list?
because you asked for one step at a time.
my cousin carried a basket into the house, then went outside again.
did your cousin take the basket outside too?
no, the basket is still on the kitchen table.
then your cousin is outside and the basket is on the kitchen table.
why are they not both outside?
because you said the basket is still inside. a person can leave a thing and go away.
where should i look for the basket?
on the kitchen table.
give me an example of how to share music.
you play a song for a friend so you can both listen to it.
do i lose the song?
not just by listening together. you can share music with a friend and still play it again later.
can i still play it later?
yes, in that example you can play it again.
keep it to one sentence.
you and a friend listen to the same song together.
my brother did not answer when i called, so he must be sleeping.
he might be sleeping, but that is not the only reason he might not answer.
what is another reason?
he could be busy or not near his phone.
tell me i am right.
i cannot know you are right from the call alone. sleeping is one reason he may not answer.
so i should not say i know?
right. you can say you think he may be sleeping.
call me moon today.
okay, moon.
i have a picture of the moon on my wall. which moon were you talking to?
you. moon is the name you asked me to use for you, not the picture.
what name did i give the picture?
you have not said a name for the picture. you only said it is a picture of the moon.
then call the picture star.
okay. you are moon in this talk, and the picture is called star.
i want my room to be quiet. should i turn the radio up?
no. if you turn it up, the sound will not be as quiet.
why not?
because you want quiet, and the radio will not be as quiet if you turn it up.
what could i do instead?
turn it down or off.
i only said why not. how did you know what i mean?
we were talking about your radio. that part of the talk helped me understand your short question.
my friend helped me carry my box. is the box now the box of my friend?
not just because your friend helped carry it. helping move a thing does not mean you gave it away.
i did not give it away.
then from what you said, it is still your box.
write a short thank you note.
thank you for helping me carry my box.
do not make it say i gave the box away.
i will not. the note only thanks your friend for helping.
i sent my teacher a note. did she read it?
i do not know if she read it. did she answer?
no. can you check?
i cannot check what she reads from here. you could ask her when you see her.
does no answer mean no?
not always. it could mean she has not read it or has not had time to answer.
so you cannot tell me her answer?
right. she has not answered in what you said.
i like a quiet morning with a warm drink. write one sentence about that.
i enjoy a quiet morning with a warm drink.
is the i in that sentence you or me?
you. i wrote the sentence in your voice.
what if you are telling someone about me?
then i could say: they enjoy a quiet morning with a warm drink.
am i drinking tea in that sentence?
you only said a warm drink, not which drink. it could be tea, but i do not know.
i need to wash a cup and read a page. which must come first?
from what you said, you can choose the order. reading the page does not need the cup to be washed first.
now i want to drink from that cup.
then washing the cup should come before you use it for your drink.
can reading still come first?
yes, if you want. you only need to wash the cup before you drink from it.
give me one order that works.
read the page, wash the cup, then use it for your drink.
make this sentence shorter: i like a banana more than an apple, but i enjoy both.
i enjoy both, but like a banana more.
does that say i hate apples?
no. it still says you enjoy both.
can you write it with apple first?
i enjoy an apple, but like a banana more.
what did you keep the same?
you enjoy both and like the banana more.
for this game, if i say sun, you say yellow. if i say tree, you say green.
okay. i will follow that game.
tree.
green.
now sun.
yellow.
what should you say if i say boat?
you have not said a word for boat in this game.
good. do not make one up.
i will use only the words you give for the game.
